WHAT_THIS_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_PRODUCE.headline: THE DETECTOR WORKS AND IT DOES NOT BY ITSELF PRODUCE A RATE. It produces CANDIDATES at a volume that requires reading, and 5 have been read.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_PRODUCE.why_255_IS_NOT_THE_RATE: DERIVED includes POOLED AND SECONDARY ANALYSES SPANNING SEVERAL TRIALS. PMID 24081972 is listed by FIVE dabigatran registrations and PMID 22709460 by three; those are pooled analyses, not one trial registered twice. 193 of the 255 are DERIVED-only. Reporting 255 as an overcount rate would be exactly the error of reading a title match as an estimand, one class along.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_PRODUCE.so_the_honest_claim: ONE confirmed instance of registry-derived k inflation, found only because a publication named both identifiers. The detector surfaces 205 two-registration candidates that a registry-only method cannot distinguish from it. WHETHER THAT IS A RATE IS UNKNOWN until they are read, and the paper should say so rather than quote 205 or 255.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_PRODUCE.the_cheap_discriminator_that_does_NOT_ex: Sponsor identity and enrolment overlap would narrow it, and both are inference rather than evidence. The only thing that settles a pair is the publication saying what the second registration is.
